title.en: Chapter 24 — The Cruise of the Coracle

sentences.en: The waves threw me far from the shore.

sentences.ar: المركب كان يدور معي بلا اتجاه.
sentences.en: The boat spun with me in no direction.
When I woke, the sun was high.
I saw the Hispaniola close to me.

sentences.ar: كانت تمشي غريب، زي ما في حدا يقودها.
sentences.en: She was moving strangely, as if nobody were steering her.
